_about: Public-domain B. F. Westcott (1825-1901, Regius Professor of Divinity at Cambridge, then Bishop of Durham) for the Word Hoard: the commentaries on the Gospel of John (the Greek text, London: Murray, 1908, 2 vols; and the Authorised Version, 1892), the Epistles of John (third edition, 1892) and Hebrews (second edition, 1892), and the General Survey of the History of the Canon of the New Testament (1896), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Overlap: PR #11's build_commentaries.py builds verse-keyed editions of Westcott on Hebrews and on the Epistles of John, and plans John next; this shelf's raw OCR of the same works is a second copy, and Adam picks which is the reading of record. Greek in the text layers (2026-10-03): John vol. 1 65,554 Greek characters, vol. 2 80,514, Hebrews 176,106, Epistles of John 79,175; the John (AV) and Canon volumes carry none.

westcott-john-greek-1: The Gospel according to St. John: the Greek text with introduction and notes, vol. 1 (London: Murray, 1908)
westcott-john-greek-2: The Gospel according to St. John: the Greek text with introduction and notes, vol. 2 (London: Murray, 1908)
westcott-john-av-1892: The Gospel according to St. John: the Authorised Version with introduction and notes (London: Murray, 1892)
westcott-canon-1896: A General Survey of the History of the Canon of the New Testament (London: Macmillan, 1896)
westcott-hebrews-1892: The Epistle to the Hebrews: the Greek text with notes and essays, second edition (London: Macmillan, 1892)
westcott-epistles-john-1892: The Epistles of St. John: the Greek text with notes and essays, third edition (Cambridge and London: Macmillan, 1892)
